title: Ambulance Evacuation for Accident Victims and Seriously Ill Patients
what_it_is: Ambulance Evacuation for Accident Victims and Seriously Ill Patients

sections.label: SCDF emergency ambulance call volume
sections.summary: SCDF EMS responded to over 155,000 calls in 2014, meeting the 11-minute target in 83% of cases, up from 78% in 2013.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Singapore Civil Defence Force (SCDF)'s Emergency Medical Services (EMS) responded to more than 155,000 calls in 2014.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: This means that there are more than 400 calls a day.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Despite the high volume of calls, SCDF has responded to 83% of these cases within 11 minutes in 2014.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: This was an improvement from 78% in 2013.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The number of emergency ambulance calls has been increasing at a rate of about 5% a year.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: At this rate of growth, we can expect the number of calls to double in 15 years' time.

sections.label: SCDF tiered response model
sections.summary: SCDF will increasingly adopt a tiered response model to channel resources to areas of greatest need.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: First, SCDF will be increasingly adopting a tiered response model so that resources are channelled to areas of greatest need.

sections.label: Conveying patients to nearest hospital
sections.summary: SCDF conveys patients needing emergency medical treatment to the nearest available MOH-designated hospital via the fastest possible route.

sentences.speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
sentences.text: Based on this principle, SCDF conveys patients requiring emergency medical treatment to the nearest available MOH-designated hospital based on the fastest possible route.
